findings.message: Camunda 7 does not subscribe messages by correlationKey; the key is dropped.
findings.suggestion: Correlate with a business key or correlation variables when sending the message.

xml:
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL" xmlns:camunda="http://camunda.org/schema/1.0/bpmn" id="d" targetNamespace="http://bpmn.io/schema/bpmn">
  <bpmn:message id="m" name="go"/>
  <bpmn:process id="p" isExecutable="true">
    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="e">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition messageRef="m"/>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>
  </bpmn:process>
</bpmn:definitions>
